question: Is Arathor's Spear an eligible input for Khaz Algar Milling, despite being a TWW herb, and may it be admitted as a new herb-to-pigment conversion?

firsthandAuthors.author: Jonar
firsthandAuthors.claim: Arathor's Spear did not appear as millable with herbs in reagent bag; moving between bank, reagent bank and warband bank did not resolve selector omission.

firsthandAuthors.author: Boxie
firsthandAuthors.claim: Milling UI showed a one-available indicator while a stack of ten Arathor's Spear was held, but the herb remained absent from selector.

firsthandAuthors.author: Rinoacross
firsthandAuthors.claim: Still unable to mill Arathor's Spear.

findings.note: Single discussion thread with multiple firsthand commenters; distinct authors but NOT controlled cast studies.

firsthandAuthors.author: Distinction
firsthandAuthors.claim: Arathor's Spear was not present in the Milling selection despite 500 herbs in inventory; same author also posted in 2024 bug thread in March 2025, so this is one author lineage.

findings.note: Other replies infer intended exclusion, but no Blizzard developer statement confirms permanent design intent.

findings.claim: Comment lists Mycobloom, Luredrop, Orbinid and Blessing Blossom as the four milling pigment families; Arathor's Spear is used as a crafting reagent elsewhere, not identified as a milling pigment input.
The milling path explicitly uses Mycobloom and Luredrop; does not independently establish an exhaustive eligible-herb universe.

inferenceLimits: Selector absence is evidence of observed ineligibility or persistent UI defect, NOT proof of intentional permanent prohibition or proof of an impossible item ID.
No author recorded a successful completed Arathor milling cast, pigment output ID, output rank, zero-inclusive output count, skill/gear/spec or build number.
The Sep 2024 UI availability badge is not proof of actual selectable recipe or successful conversion.
A failed selection is not a completed cast with zero output; do not encode dropChance=0 or expectedQuantity=0.
Held stack quantities 119, 10 and 500 are NOT cast counts or denominators.
March 2025 Distinction appears in two threads; count one author, not two independent cohorts.
Source publication dates are not exact in-game build identifiers; 2026 Retail eligibility remains unverified.
reason: The 12 queued TWW milling E-gap mappings concern Mycobloom, Luredrop, Orbinid and Blessing Blossom; none uses Arathor's Spear.

measurementRequest.question: On current 2026 Retail build, do any of Arathor's Spear R1/R2/R3 item IDs appear in Khaz Algar Milling's reagent selector and complete a cast?
measurementRequest.procedure: Capture build/version, exact item ID and rank, ten herbs in character bags, selector list and any UI availability badge, then repeat with bank/reagent bank/warbank; record learned Inscription, skill/spec/gear and any error. Only if selectable, complete a controlled cast and capture actual inputs, refunds, exact output IDs/ranks, and zero-inclusive outputs. Do not record UI rejection as a zero-output cast.

blockers: No current-Retail client or 2026 video with exact Arathor rank and successful/failed selector demonstration.
No developer-confirmed permanent intended exclusion versus longstanding UI defect.
No successful completed Arathor milling cast or identified pigment output to support a mapping.
